# Select

One choice from a list, drawn as a filled field with a chevron; the native control.

- Status: implemented
- Category: input
- Pattern: HTML `<select> with <label>`
- Text style: `body` (`.nd-text-body`)

## Anatomy

- **label**: As a text field.
- **control**: The native select, appearance removed.
- **chevron**: Decorative, not focusable.

## Variants

- `native`: The platform's own picker (preferred on touch).

## States

- `default`
- `hover`
- `focus-visible`
- `disabled`
- `invalid`: As a text field.

## Keyboard

| Keys | Action |
| --- | --- |
| Arrow keys | Change the choice. |
| Space, Alt+Down | Open the list. |

## Accessibility

- Role: combobox (native select)
- Name: The label element.
- A custom listbox is used only where the native control cannot work (multi-select with search).

WCAG 2.2 success criteria:

- 1.3.1 Info and Relationships (A)
- 1.4.3 Contrast (Minimum) (AA)
- 1.4.11 Non-text Contrast (AA)
- 2.4.7 Focus Visible (AA)
- 2.4.13 Focus Appearance (AAA)
- 3.3.2 Labels or Instructions (A)
- 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value (A)

## Web example

From the reference page:

```html
<div class="nd-field nd-field--select">
  <label class="nd-field__label" for="ex-select">Topic</label>
  <select class="nd-field__control" id="ex-select">
    <option>Development</option>
    <option>Research</option>
  </select>
  <span class="nd-field__chevron" aria-hidden="true"
    ><svg
      class="nd-icon nd-icon--down"
      viewBox="0 0 24 24"
      fill="none"
      aria-hidden="true"
      focusable="false"
    >
      <path
        d="M12 4.5 6.3 10.2l1.2 1.2 3.6-3.6v12h1.8v-12l3.6 3.6 1.2-1.2z"
        fill="currentColor"
      /></svg
  ></span>
</div>
```
